primary_findings: Integrated minus LightGCN reduces DVR by 0.001103 and squared risk by 0.0000510, while NDCG decreases by 0.000874 and MRR by 0.001192; the Recall interval includes zero.
Post-hoc minus LightGCN reduces DVR by 0.007064 and squared risk by 0.000355, while Recall decreases by 0.002212 and NDCG by 0.001553.
Post-hoc minus integrated reduces DVR by 0.005960 and squared risk by 0.000304, while Recall decreases by 0.002392 and NDCG by 0.000679; the MRR interval includes zero.
BPR-MF has the highest mean Recall and NDCG; XSimGCL has the highest mean MRR but substantially higher overchallenge risk among learned models.
Popularity has the lowest risk but much lower relevance and is not evidence of a useful personalized trade-off.
interpretation: The final evidence supports an accuracy-overchallenge trade-off, not universal dominance of integrated regularization over post-hoc reranking.
